arabic text: AAJ KABRE MUSTAFA PAR EK HUJOOME AAM HEY
english translation text: TODAY THERE IS A CROWD OF PEOPLE AT THE TOMB OF RASUL ALLAH

arabic text: AA GAYI ZAINAB MADINE – ME BAPA KOHRAM HEY\nAAJ KABRE MUSTAFA PAR EK HUJOOME AAM HEY
english translation text: TODAY THERE IS A CROWD OF PEOPLE AT THE TOMB OF RASUL ALLAH\nZAINAB HAS RETURNED TO MADINA, THERE IS A COMMOTION,

arabic text: RAKH KE KURTA BHAI KA TUR – BAT PE ZAYNAB NE KAHA KHIDMATE ISLAM PAR UMMAT KA YE INAAM HEY
english translation text: ZAINAB PLACED HER BROTHER'S SHIRT ON THE GRAVE AND SAID,\nTHIS IS THE REWARD THE PEOPLE HAVE GIVEN US FOR OUR SERVICES TO ISLAM.

english translation text: TODAY THERE IS A CROWD OF PEOPLE AT THE TOMB OF RASUL ALLAH\nZAINAB HAS RETURNED TO MADINA, THERE IS A COMMOTION,

arabic text: HICHKYOME NAAZ – KI TARPAYENGI SUGRA KI YAAD LAB – PE AKBAR KE DAME AAKHAR BAHAN KA NAAM HEY
english translation text: IN THE FINAL BREATHS OF LIFE, THOUGHTS OF SUGHRA WILL DISTURB AKBAR,\nAND IN THE LAST MOMENTS, AKBAR HAS HIS SISTER'S NAME UPON HIS LIPS

english translation text: TODAY THERE IS A CROWD OF PEOPLE AT THE TOMB OF RASUL ALLAH\nZAINAB HAS RETURNED TO MADINA, THERE IS A COMMOTION,

arabic text: JUK GAYE HEY NAWJAWAN KI LAASH PAR RAN ME HUSSEIN KYA ALI AKBER KE HOTO PAR KOI PEYGAAM HEY
english translation text: HUSAIN HAS BOWED DOWN OVER THE YOUNG MAN'S BODY IN THE BATTLEFIELD,\nIS THERE ANY FINAL MESSAGE ALI AKBAR WANTS TO CONVEY?

arabic text: AA GAYI ZAINAB MADINE – ME BAPA KOHRAM HEY\nAAJ KABRE MUSTAFA PAR EK HUJOOME AAM HEY
english translation text: TODAY THERE IS A CROWD OF PEOPLE AT THE TOMB OF RASUL ALLAH\nZAINAB HAS RETURNED TO MADINA, THERE IS A COMMOTION,

arabic text: NAAM PARKE LAASH BETE,\nKI DIKHAA KAR BOLE SHAAH, YE HEY SUGHRA KI TAMANNA, ISKA AKBER NAAM HEY
english translation text: HUSAIN CARRIES THE BODY OF HIS SON AND SAYS,\nTHIS IS THE HOPE OF SUGHRA, HIS NAME IS AKBAR.

arabic text: KEHTITHI FIZZA CHINI JAATI HEY ZAINAB KI RIDAA YA ALI AAWO MADAD KAR – NA TUMHARA KAAM HEY
english translation text: FIZZA USED TO SAY, THE VEIL OF ZAINAB IS BEING SNATCHED AWAY,\nO IMAM ALI, PLEASE COME, AND HELP!

arabic text: HURMALA NE PYAAS BACCHE, KI BUJAADI TIR SE JAANTA THA ASGHARE BESHEER TISHNA KAAM HEY
english translation text: HURMALA QUENCHED THE CHILD'S THIRST WITH AN ARROW,\nHE KNEW ASGHAR HAD NOT DRUNK MILK FOR DAYS
